name: magpie-agent-kiki
description: Kiki as a magpie agent: pick one of magpie's models for it. The Magpie plugin writes the model into ~/.kiki/config.toml from its Bun host; the same folder is also an optional Kiki plugin for a session-start sync.

scripts.check: node --check kiki.agent.js && node --check kiki.host.js && node --check lib/bridge.mjs && node --check hooks/sync.mjs
